events.title: Lightspill (mirrored-sphere art installation)
events.when: Thursday 10/29 to Monday 11/9 · times not posted
events.summary: Lightspill is a large temporary public art installation by Friends of Downtown on the front of the historic Artel Gallery building in downtown Pensacola. Hundreds of mirrored spheres appear to pour over the facade, and the look changes through the day with light and weather. It's free and open to the public, from October 29 to November 9, as part of Foo Foo Festival.

events.title: Mobile in the Gilded Age exhibition at the History Museum of Mobile
events.when: Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM · Sunday 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM · through 6/6/2027
events.summary: The History Museum of Mobile opened Mobile in the Gilded Age on October 9, 2026, and the exhibition stays up through June 6, 2027. Gowns, inventions and everyday objects show how railroads, new technology and department stores changed life in Mobile in the late 1800s and early 1900s. The exhibition also covers the unequal opportunities and segregation of the period.
